subject: Rename memory → johnny: Database tables and migrations
description:
Create Alembic migration to rename database tables from memory_* to johnny_* in Agent Hub.

**Project:** Agent Hub (~/agent-hub/)

**Skills:** Use `/alembic-migrations` for migration patterns, `/sqlalchemy-2-async` for model updates.

**Scope:**
- Rename tables: memory_settings → johnny_settings, memory_injection_metrics → johnny_injection_metrics
- Update SQLAlchemy model __tablename__ attributes
- Create reversible Alembic migration
- Update any raw SQL queries referencing old table names

**Files:**
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/models/memory.py (if exists)
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/models.py (new location)
- ~/agent-hub/backend/alembic/versions/xxx_rename_memory_to_johnny.py (new migration)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Alembic migration created and tested
- [ ] Migration is reversible (upgrade/downgrade work)
- [ ] SQLAlchemy models updated with new table names
- [ ] `alembic upgrade head` succeeds
- [ ] No data loss during migration
- [ ] `dt --check` passes

**Context Check:** If >= 60%, /compact first. If >= 75%, /commit_it then /compact.

**Completion:** Run /commit_it after verification passes.
